title: Add a folder to Finder sidebar
summary: Pin a specific folder or file to the Finder sidebar favorites using its name and path.

steps.explain: Add an item to the end of the Finder sidebar favorites. Replace <NAME> with the label you want to see and <URL> with the file:// path to the folder or file.

placeholders.name: NAME
placeholders.description: The display name for the sidebar item

placeholders.name: URL
placeholders.description: The file:// URL of the item to add
